newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL - HEX seen closing around 2,280 at end-1996.
newsitem.headline: POLL - HEX seen closing around 2,280 at end-1996.

text.p: The Helsinki HEX general share index is expected to close around 2,280 points at the end of 1996, up from 2,263.32 on November 13, a consensus of share analysts surveyed by Reuters showed.
The 14 forecasts collected November 8-12 ranged from 2,070 to 2,378.

The mean of the forecasts would mean a 33 percent rise for the HEX index compared to end-1995. The four most optimistic forecast saw the all-share index exceeding this year its life-high of 2,346.26 set on September 15, 1995.
The forest industry sub-index was seen closing at 1,993 at the end of 1996, down from a 1,999.98 close on November 13.
The bank and finance sub-index was seen at 583, up from 562.43, and the metal industry sub-index at 2,773, up from 2,764.58.

The mean of analysts' forecasts for telecommunications group Nokia Oy's share price (A series) at the end of 1996 was 240 markka. Analysts were polled before the release, due on Thursday around 1200/1000 GMT of Nokia's January-September interim report.
Nokia closed at 227.00 markka in Helsinki on November 13.

Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Arctos Securities, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities Finland, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FSB, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock, Postipankki, Svenska Handelsbanken and Williams De Broe.
